login nahi ho pa raha
help chahiye
haan bhai
wait kar raha hu
address wahi hai

items.context: Did you receive the OTP on your registered mobile number?
items.text: nahin nahi mila

items.context: Is your registered mobile number still active with you?
items.text: phone change kar diya

items.context: Should I resend the OTP to your number now?
items.text: code dubara bhejo
mera net banking me login nahi ho raha hai
otp baar baar galat aa raha hai mujhe
mobile number update karna hai pehle se alag number hai
password reset karne par bhi confirmation nahi mil raha
kya aap mujhe fir se otp bhej sakte ho
phone ki network problem ho rahi hai warna sab theek hai
account me paise baad me transfer karna hai thoda der ho sakti hai

items.context: Please confirm if your registered mobile number is active and reachable?
items.text: mere number pe otp nahi aa raha hai kya karu

items.context: Have you tried logging in multiple times with wrong credentials?
items.text: kya mera account block to nahi hua hai jayada galat attempts ke wajah se

items.context: Since when are you experiencing this issue with OTP delivery?
items.text: kab se aapko ye problem aa rahi hai kya aapne recent updates kiye hain

items.context: Can you please check your phone settings and try again?
items.text: phone ki settings check karunga aur dubara try karunga

items.context: Do you want to update your registered mobile number now?
items.text: kya mera registered number change karna possible hai is call ke through
main apna net banking account use nahi kar pa raha hu kyunki mujhe otp nahi mil raha hai isliye login nahi ho pa raha
mera phone naya hai aur mobile banking setup nahi hua hai toh main apne account me login kar kaise paunga

items.context: Have you checked if the registered mobile number on your account is correct and active?
items.text: main apke kehne ke mutabik registered mobile number ko check kar liya lekin fir bhi otp nahi aa raha hai

items.context: Can you tell me since how many days you are facing issue with OTP delivery for login?
items.text: karib ek hafte se jab mai login karne ki koshish karta hu tab mujhe otp nahi milta hai is wajah se transaction bhi nahi hota hai

items.context: Do you think your phone network issue is causing the delay in receiving the OTP?
items.text: mera phone network problem kar raha hai shayad isi wajah se otp nahi aa rahe hai mujhe thoda time de ke check karna hai

request.system:
You write realistic things that customers say to a voice agent on a phone call in India.
Write what the customer says out loud, as speech recognition would transcribe it:
natural spoken word order, fillers kept, no punctuation needed.
Each utterance is one complete customer turn: the customer has finished speaking
and is waiting for the agent to reply.
request.user:
Domain: banking
Intent: login_otp_problem - cannot log in to net or mobile banking or is not receiving the OTP
Language: Hindi-English code-mixed, entirely in Latin script (e.g. 'mera account se paise kat gaye but transfer nahi hua').
Style for this batch: plain and direct

Write exactly 24 different customer turns in these six groups:
- "short": exactly 3 turns of 1-4 words (for example 'haan ji', 'kal tak', 'theek hai'),
- "short_with_context": exactly 3 turns of 1-4 words, each with the agent's question before it,
- "medium": exactly 7 turns of 5-12 words,
- "medium_with_context": exactly 5 turns of 5-12 words, each with the agent's question before it,
- "long": exactly 3 turns of 13-30 words,
- "long_with_context": exactly 3 turns of 13-30 words, each with the agent's question before it.
In the *_with_context groups, "context" is the question the agent asked just before that turn.
Vary people, amounts, dates, names and places. Do not number them. Do not start two turns the same way.
Return JSON: {"short": [{"text": "..."}, ...], "short_with_context": [{"text": "...", "context": "..."}, ...],
"medium": [...], "medium_with_context": [...], "long": [...], "long_with_context": [...]}
Every turn and question must be in Latin script.
